create_make_zero_core_profiles: create a zero-initialized CoreProfiles object for a given geometry with optional custom electron temperature and impurity values
create_make_constant_core_profile: create a constant-value CellVariable core profile for a given geometry and scalar value
test_verify_core_profiles: test that core profiles match reference profile data at a given simulation index
build_zero_core_profiles: build a dummy CoreProfiles object with all fields zeroed for unit testing torax simulations
review_verify_core_profiles: review the core profile verification function that asserts T_e, T_i, n_e, n_i, psi, psidot, q_face, s_face, j_total, and Ip_profile match references
